ref5602_production_schedule.note: Uses backends.SCRIPTS['REF-5602'] directly (the schedule run_eval.py actually executes), not build_script()'s generic single-query path.

methodology_note: Both schedules are executed independently from a clean observation set via tools.call() for every case; each record is built from ITS OWN observations by decide_from_observations(), not copied from a shared final. Token/cost figures are SCRIPTED ESTIMATES (backends.ScriptedBackend.token_estimate's formula), not measurements.
note: Deterministic scripted backend: repeated trials of the same case are identical by construction. Trial counts follow harness.py's convention (negative cases x3, ordinary x1), matching the rest of the report.
